reach: John J. Radcliffe Conservation Area to Patton Park
endpointName: Patton Park / Campbell’s Bridge river access
selectionReason: Petersburg's current adopted comprehensive-plan materials identify Patton Park as a public waterfront access site with multiple paved ramps to the Appomattox River. The same city plan identifies Patton Park as an anchor/regional park with natural kayak/canoe launch and fishing access, while FOLAR describes Patton Park as the flatwater start of the lower Appomattox River Trail. Retain the stored point as a conditional park/take-out access anchor; the 391-foot connected-network offset reflects the park/shoreline facility and bridge context rather than a wrong river endpoint.
